item_name: Rothco Thin Silver Line Flag Low Pro Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco's Thin Silver Line Flag Low Pro Cap shows support of correction officers.
description: Rothco's Thin Silver Line Flag Low Pro Cap shows support of correction officers.  This thin silver line low pro cap features a 100% cotton material with a US flag. This thin silver hat features an adjustable hook and loop closure with a 100% brushed cotton twill crown.  This cap also features a cotton twill sweatband for comfortability and a front panel with buckram.
